title: TENIR-Gov: Governance Middleware for AI-Enabled Operational Systems
description:
TENIR-Gov is an open-source governance middleware that sits between decision-producing AI agents and downstream execution environments. It enforces explicit policies, validates operational intents through a neuro-symbolic grammar layer, and persists every governance decision in a cryptographically verifiable Merkle-based audit ledger — independently of any underlying AI model.

Release 5.4.3 provides: neuro-symbolic validation (LALR(1) grammar + optional LLM fine-tuning), a deterministic policy engine (frozen dataclass contract), a graph-based policy store (Neo4j 5.x), a Merkle epoch audit ledger, an administrative governance plane, a polymorphic UI surface contract, ledger migration tooling, two-kernel composition with HOLD/ESCALATE lifecycle, post-execution assessment (τ⁻¹ partial tau inversion + EVP), a hardened I8 aggregate budget invariant with governor-owned reservation, and CAVE aligned to the doctrinal definition (Control / Aim / Veto / Epistemics).
notes: Release 5.4.3: TENIR 2.0 schema 1.2 kernel, runtime constraint geometry, connectors, R5 security hardening, two-kernel composition, post-execution assessment layer, I8 budget coordination fix, and CAVE doctrinal alignment (Control/Aim/Veto/Epistemics). Validation is performed through the repository CI gate. Policy fingerprint (default): d083e0b82a16c04d0.
